image_description: A large, teal and white airship (dirigible) with 'DREAMLAND' text on the side is parked on a grassy field. The airship has an elongated cigar shape with a pointed nose featuring an orange circular design. A gondola structure is visible beneath the hull. In the background, there are trees and a stone castle-like structure. In the foreground, the partial roof of a grey car is visible.
